definitions.explanation: An increase in one's regular salary or wages.

examples.japanese: {今年|ことし}は{昇給|しょうきゅう}があった。
examples.english: I got a pay raise this year.

examples.japanese: {業績|ぎょうせき}が{良|よ}ければ{昇給|しょうきゅう}が{期待|きたい}できる。
examples.english: If performance is good, you can expect a salary increase.

examples.japanese: {定期|ていき}{昇給|しょうきゅう}は{年|ねん}に１{回|かい}だ。
examples.english: Regular salary increases happen once a year.

notes:
{昇給|しょうきゅう} is a compound: {昇|しょう} (rise) + {給|きゅう} (salary).

TYPES:
- {定期|ていき}{昇給|しょうきゅう} (regular/scheduled raise)
- ベースアップ (base pay increase, often abbreviated ベア)
- {業績|ぎょうせき}{連動|れんどう}の{昇給|しょうきゅう} (performance-based raise)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {昇給|しょうきゅう}する (to receive a pay raise)
- {昇給|しょうきゅう}がある (to have a pay raise)
- {昇給|しょうきゅう}を{期待|きたい}する (to expect a raise)
- {昇給|しょうきゅう}{交渉|こうしょう} (salary negotiation)

RELATED VOCABULARY:
- {昇進|しょうしん} (promotion)
- {減給|げんきゅう} (salary reduction)
- {給与|きゅうよ} (salary, wages)
